LCD DISPLAY
===========

INTERFACE 1
-----------

.. image:: renderers/web/assets/je100c_eu_en/lcd_interface_1.png
   :alt: LCD interface 1 device display
   :width: 72%

.. list-table::
   :class: hb-lcd-icon-table
   :widths: 6 12 27 55

   * - 1
     - .. image:: renderers/web/assets/je100c_eu_shared/lcd_input.png
          :alt: Input Power
     - Input Power
     - Displays the input power in watts.
   * - 2
     - .. image:: renderers/web/assets/je100c_eu_shared/lcd_charge_time.png
          :alt: Remaining Charging Time
     - Remaining Charging Time
     - Displays the remaining charging time.
   * - 3
     - .. image:: renderers/web/assets/je100c_eu_shared/lcd_steady.png
          :alt: Steady-on Mode
     - Steady-on Mode
     - | On: Steady-on Mode is enabled.
       | Off: Steady-on Mode is disabled.
   * - 4
     - .. image:: renderers/web/assets/je100c_eu_shared/lcd_thermal.png
          :alt: Thermal Power Limiting
     - Thermal Power Limiting
     - | On: The battery temperature is high. Discharging Power Limit is enabled.
       | Off: Discharging Power Limit is disabled.
   * - 5
     - .. image:: renderers/web/assets/je100c_eu_shared/lcd_energy.png
          :alt: Energy Saving Mode
     - Energy Saving Mode
     - | On: Energy Saving Mode is enabled.
       | Off: Energy Saving Mode is disabled.
   * - 6
     - .. image:: renderers/web/assets/je100c_eu_shared/lcd_ring.png
          :alt: Battery Power Indicator
     - Battery Power Indicator
     - When the product is being charged, the orange circle around the battery percentage will light up in sequence. When charging other devices, the orange circle will stay on.
   * - 7
     - .. image:: renderers/web/assets/je100c_eu_shared/lcd_low_battery.png
          :alt: Battery Power Indicator
     - Battery Power Indicator
     - | On: The battery level is below 20%.
       | Blink: The battery level is below 5%.
       | Off: The battery level is not below 20% or the product is charging.
   * - 8
     - .. image:: renderers/web/assets/je100c_eu_shared/lcd_percentage.png
          :alt: Remaining Battery Percentage
     - Remaining Battery Percentage
     - Displays the remaining battery percentage.
   * - 9
     - .. image:: renderers/web/assets/je100c_eu_shared/lcd_discharge_time.png
          :alt: Remaining Discharge Time
     - Remaining Discharge Time
     - Displays the remaining discharging time.
   * - 10
     - .. image:: renderers/web/assets/je100c_eu_shared/lcd_output.png
          :alt: Output Power
     - Output Power
     - Displays the output power in watts.
.. list-table::
   :class: hb-lcd-icon-table lcd-unnumbered
   :widths: 18 25 57

   * - .. image:: renderers/web/assets/je100c_eu_shared/lcd_fault.png
        :alt: Fault code
     - Fault code
     - Remove the load or unplug the charging plug. If the problem cannot be resolved, please contact the Jackery Customer Support.
   * - .. image:: renderers/web/assets/je100c_eu_shared/lcd_high_temperature.png
        :alt: High Temperature Indicator
     - High Temperature Indicator
     - High temperature protection is triggered. The product may stop functioning until its temperature returns to the normal operating range.
   * - .. image:: renderers/web/assets/je100c_eu_shared/lcd_low_temperature.png
        :alt: Low Temperature Indicator
     - Low Temperature Indicator
     - Low temperature protection is triggered. The product may stop functioning until its temperature returns to the normal operating range.


INTERFACE 2
-----------

.. image:: renderers/web/assets/je100c_eu_en/lcd_interface_2.png
   :alt: LCD interface 2 device display
   :width: 88%

.. list-table::
   :class: hb-lcd-icon-table
   :widths: 6 12 27 55

   * - 1
     - .. image:: renderers/web/assets/je100c_eu_shared/lcd_discharging.png
          :alt: Discharging Indicator
     - Discharging Indicator
     - This USB port is discharging.
   * - 2
     - .. image:: renderers/web/assets/je100c_eu_shared/lcd_charging.png
          :alt: Charging Indicator
     - Charging Indicator
     - This USB port is charging.
   * - 3
     - .. image:: renderers/web/assets/je100c_eu_shared/lcd_watts.png
          :alt: Charging or Discharging Power
     - Charging or Discharging Power
     - Displays charging or discharging power of the corresponding port.


INTERFACE 3
-----------

.. image:: renderers/web/assets/je100c_eu_en/lcd_interface_3.png
   :alt: LCD interface 3 device display
   :width: 64%

.. list-table::
   :class: hb-lcd-icon-table
   :widths: 6 12 27 55

   * - 1
     - .. image:: renderers/web/assets/je100c_eu_shared/lcd_health.png
          :alt: Battery Health and Cycle Count
     - Battery Health and Cycle Count
     - Displays the current battery health percentage and the number of charge/discharge cycles.

       - **Green:** Battery health is high.
       - **Yellow:** Battery health is moderate.
       - **Red:** Battery health is low.
   * - 2
     - .. image:: renderers/web/assets/je100c_eu_shared/lcd_temperature.png
          :alt: Battery Temperature
     - Battery Temperature
     - Displays the current battery temperature.
